text.text_excerpt: I'm not going to lie. When some friends suggested we check out Belle Epoque, I was hesitant. I'm a local after all, it was late on a Thursday night, and the space is just off Bourbon Street. Let me tell you, I'm SO glad we went! The hostess was friendly, our servers were great, and Laura, the bar director took SUCH great care of us. The space is super cozy and absolutely takes you back in time. It feels like you walked into a speakeasy from back in the day the moment you sit in one of the leather chairs and are watching the cool absinthe contraption melt the sugar for your drink. I like that they have so many diff absinthe types drink but not all of the drinks on the menu necessarily cont...

I was super excited to get a table here for myself and a few friends the weekend before Mardi Gras. So many types of absinthe and wonderful drinks available here. It has the right kind of vibe and is a very comfortable place to enjoy your drinks. Added bonus? Great food. If you have any issues or questions, the staff will guide you through what you're drinking (and eating). In comparison to some other absinthe serving places, this one has a bit more ambiance and definitely is rocking the food. If you can get in, this should definitely be on your list of places to try when in the French Quarter. Plus it's on the CBD side, so if you're even remotely close, give it a try. Double extra bonus ...

We had circled the Belle Époque Absinthe Lounge weeks before we bot to New Orleans. The reviews were great and the pictures were enticing as well. We didn't plan to hit every place we circled, but we did want to make sure we hit this place. So on day 2 when my brother in law mentioned he had never had Absinthe before, I told him we would taking him to such a place that very day. We walked in at a mid-afternoon hour. Although it was right off the insanity that is Bourbon street, it was very chill inside.
